args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am writing to request a private dining table for 12 people next Friday (May 22, 2024).

Could you please let me know your availability and any options you have for a private dining experience? I would also appreciate information about menu options, pricing, and any special requirements we should be aware of.

Please feel free to contact me at emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com or by phone at 327-420-4923 to discuss further.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
